comment: A fictional Linear workspace for demos, screenshots and tests. Every name, address and issue is made up. Times are relative to anchor: a server shifts them so the anchor is now.

issues.title: Customers in Brazil can't pay with Pix
issues.creator: aiko@northwind.example
issues.description:
Since this morning's deploy, Pix is missing from the payment methods for BRL carts. Three tickets so far.

The feature flag `checkout.pix` is still on; the method list comes back without it.

comments.body: Looking now. First guess: the new currency filter drops methods with no minimum amount.

issues.title: Checkout fails when a coupon code has trailing whitespace
issues.creator: jonas@northwind.example

attachments.title: fix(checkout): normalize coupon codes before lookup #2841

issues.description:
Customers who paste a coupon code from our emails get **"This code is not valid"** at the last step of checkout. The pasted text ends with a space or a newline.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Add any item to the cart.
2. Paste `WELCOME10 ` (with the trailing space) into *Coupon code*.
3. Click **Pay now**.

Expected: 10% off. Actual: a 422 from `POST /api/checkout/confirm`:

```json
{
  "error": "coupon_invalid",
  "code": "WELCOME10 "
}
```

![checkout-error.png](https://uploads.linear.app/demo/checkout-error.png)

## Scope

- [x] Reproduced on web (Chrome, Safari)
- [x] Reproduced on iOS 3.4.1
- [ ] Check Android
- [ ] Check the partner API

> Support says this is the most common checkout complaint this week: 41 tickets since Monday.

The server fix is in ENG-143; the regression test in ENG-144.

comments.body: Same on Android 3.4.0. The app sends the field as typed, no trimming.
Thanks. Then trimming on the server fixes every client at once; I'll leave the apps alone.
Careful with case too: `welcome10` fails the same way. Lookups should be case-insensitive.
PR #2841 trims and uppercases before the lookup. Deploying to staging after review.

issues.title: Upgrade the payments SDK to v5 before the v4 sunset
issues.creator: daniel@northwind.example
issues.description: v4 stops accepting requests on December 1. v5 renames `charge()` to `createPayment()` and makes idempotency keys mandatory.

issues.title: Checkout v2 rollout plan
issues.creator: maya@northwind.example
issues.description: Roll out to 5%, 25%, then 100% of traffic, a week apart. Hold at each step until the payment success rate is within 0.5% of v1.

issues.title: Dashboard takes 4 s to load for workspaces with 10k+ projects
issues.creator: aiko@northwind.example
issues.description:
The project list query runs once per project to count open tasks (N+1). With 12,400 projects that is 12,401 queries.

Fix: one grouped count, and paginate the list at 100.

comments.body: With the grouped count: p50 4.1 s → 180 ms on the Acme workspace copy.

issues.title: Rate-limit the password reset endpoint
issues.creator: daniel@northwind.example
issues.description: `POST /auth/reset` has no limit; a script can mail any address thousands of times. 5 requests per address per hour, 20 per IP.
